feature_definitions.dynamics.delta_reversal_magnitude: min(abs(velocity[t]), abs(velocity[t-1])) when their nonzero signs differ; otherwise 0
feature_definitions.dynamics.momentum_sign_streak_bars: consecutive observations sharing the exact sign of delta_velocity
feature_definitions.dynamics.momentum_z_prior: z-score of delta_velocity[t] against its strictly-prior expanding distribution
feature_definitions.dynamics.pressure_recovery: (1 - lambda[t-1]) - (1 - lambda[t]); positive values denote falling structural pressure
feature_definitions.dynamics.pressure_z_prior: z-score of 1 - lambda[t] against the strictly-prior expanding distribution; 0 for a constant prior distribution
feature_definitions.dynamics.regime_age_bars: consecutive observations with the current authoritative D_O structural_state
feature_definitions.dynamics.transition_intensity_z_prior: z-score of pairwise-available RMS change in financial_structural_vector_v2 against its strictly-prior expanding distribution
feature_definitions.multiscale.d1_w1_coherence: cosine similarity over the same six D1/W1 PRAMA coordinates
feature_definitions.multiscale.d1_w1_dispersion: RMS difference over the first six bounded PRAMA v2 coordinates between D1[t] and the latest W1 frame from a strictly earlier ISO week

ranking_rule: variant identifier for deterministic final tie-break

feature_families: prior-only pressure/momentum/transition z-scores, regime age, momentum-sign persistence, pressure recovery
